confusables.note: consensus یعنی اجماع و توافق جمعی؛ در آزمون، شباهت ظاهری همین دو کلمه دام اصلی بوده است.

homograph.note: Noun /ˈkɒnsɔːt/ (a royal spouse) and verb /kənˈsɔːt/ (to keep company with) differ in stress and part of speech, and a learner will not guess one from the other.

senses.definition: the husband or wife of a ruler, especially of a king or a queen

examples.en: The queen appeared on the balcony beside her consort.
examples.fa: ملکه در کنار همسرش روی بالکن ظاهر شد.

senses.definition: to spend time in the company of someone that other people disapprove of, used as "consort with"

examples.en: He was accused of consorting with criminals.
examples.fa: او را به معاشرت با تبهکاران متهم کردند.
